title: StockGPT thoughts.
author: stockwarrior1
selftext:
Life's been rather busy recently so I've been trying to find a better and quicker way to filter my watchlist without spending hours on screeners. Stumbled across [stockgpt.pro](http://stockgpt.pro) a few weeks back on an advertisement board in London — it runs a multi-factor ranking model across a bunch of stocks (momentum, PE, ROE, volatility, fundamental factors etc.) and scores them 0–infinity (haven't seen one above 50,000 though). Basically does the quant-ish shortlisting I was trying to do manually. 

Not a silver bullet — it's more of a starting point than a buy signal — but for cutting a 500-stock universe down to 20 worth looking at, it's been genuinely useful. The results have been crazy, the number 1 stock when I started was $MU, which is up like 150% since. Helpful that their earnings reinforced what the algorithm thought, which is that it's undervalued and a growth stock, with plenty of demand. Saying that, I don't know enough about it, and I need to use it for another 5 months (1 year total) to make a proper conclusion. Promising signs nevertheless. Anyway, thought some of you might find it useful.
